ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible contrast ratio approximately 1:1.5 between high-intensity distal patches and the low-intensity central core; the central region consists of a large, contiguous block of low-intensity (dark) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white/light gray) mottled blobs are mapped to the distal-most 35-40% of both left and right lobes. A large, high-density low-intensity (black/dark brown) region occupies the central 60% of the fluke area, extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of 65-70 degrees; the depth of the notch extends significantly into the central dark mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; the distal tips exhibit increased topographical amplitude with jagged, non-linear pixel offsets compared to the smoother interior curves of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a pronounced concave curvature sweeping from the distal tips toward the central notch; leading edges (partially visible) suggest an asymmetrical convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of circular, high-intensity pixel groups located on the distal edge of the right lobe; additional discrete high-intensity circular points are scattered within the mottled light-gray region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 4-6 parallel, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear streaks (dark lines) are visible on the distal section of the left lobe, intersecting the light-intensity mottled patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right distal tip shows a highly irregular, rugged termination with missing pixel segments relative to a smooth parabolic curve, indicating previous structural trauma or heavy encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast boundary exists where the light-intensity mottled patches transition abruptly to the dark-intensity central region, forming a distinctive bilaterally symmetrical inner-lobe border.
